timeline: 02:10 AM: Label printer spontaneously prints 'LENA ZARATE – 03:47'
02:47 AM: Iris checks the slip again, dismisses it as a glitch
03:12 AM: Ambulance arrives with 8-year-old Lena Zarate in respiratory distress
03:12 AM: Code team works the airway; Iris reaches the tray alone — no attending on the floor
03:55 AM: Label printer activates without a power source, prints 'ARTHUR BELL — 04:12'
03:55 AM: Iris watches the machine print, tries to reach for the plug that doesn't exist
03:56 AM: Lena Zarate is confirmed deceased
03:56 AM: Iris finds the Arthur Bell label warm after printing
03:56 AM: Ambulance arrives with Arthur Bell, a 65-year-old male with chest pain
03:58 AM: Iris admits Arthur Bell to critical Room 3 based on the label
03:58 AM: Paramedics express concern that Room 3 is for criticals, but Iris insists
CANON: Dr. Ovid = phone contact only, not physically present, not romantic
04:00 AM: Iris discovers a blank label with her name embossed from the printer

04:10 AM: Iris visits the archive; Mr. Hanley initially refuses but reveals the printer was not hospital property; mentions an older nurse from the 1960s who used a similar machine and was later transferred to memory care wing three floors below ground
04:10 AM: Hanley retrieves a folder with a pink plastic cafeteria token from 1963 stamped with a lighthouse; he lies about not remembering the nurse's name
04:10 AM: Hanley states the printer was in storage for twenty years and someone recently moved it to Room 3, suggesting someone wanted Iris to find it
